entries: The Agency is the business property introduced with The Contract. It is associated with Franklin's business operations, including Security Contract work and the VIP Contract story involving Dr. Dre, plus Agency-specific vehicle and weapon services where purchased.
The Acid Lab is the mobile business associated with Los Santos Drug Wars and the Freakshop. It produces product from supplies and can be upgraded after meeting the relevant progression requirements.
The Salvage Yard is a vehicle-focused business tied to Salvage Yard Robberies and Tow Truck work. It stores robbery targets and supports related income and vehicle-salvage activities.

The Bail Enforcement Office is the bounty-hunting business from Bottom Dollar Bounties. Owners can pursue standard and Most Wanted targets, process secured targets, and optionally hire Agents for additional work.

The Darnell Bros Garment Factory unlocks the FIB Files, multi-stage scores launched from the factory computer or Darnell Inc. phone app. It also adds Terrorbyte Bureau Tech options and extra property features.
McKenzie Field Hangar adds repeatable smuggling work, Oscar Guzman missions, extra aircraft storage tied to existing Smuggler Hangars, and runway access for owned Personal Aircraft.

Money Fronts adds a money-laundering operation centered on Hands On Car Wash, with Higgins Helitours and Smoke on the Water as expansion businesses. Laundering work builds Heat, which can be reduced through legitimate business work.

Hands On Car Wash is the hub property for Money Fronts. It provides money-laundering work, a passive safe whose income scales with owned businesses, and a bonus tied to Counterfeit Cash sales.
Higgins Helitours is a Money Fronts expansion business. It supports laundering work, boosts Air Freight Cargo activity, and lets owners spawn eligible helicopters at the business.
smoke on the water gta online
Smoke on the Water is a Money Fronts expansion business. It supports laundering operations, gives a bonus to Weed Farm sales, and includes a recurring weed-package collectible.

A Safehouse in the Hills added three customizable Mansion properties. Mansions can include an AI Assistant, Master Control Terminal, fast travel, business production boosts, a 20-car garage, private nightclub, vault, amenities, optional Armory, Arcade, Vehicle Workshop, pets, and other upgrades.

The Mansion AI Assistant can temporarily boost production for a selected eligible business, fast travel to owned properties and businesses, and organize Mansion parties. Rockstar lists Angel, Haviland, and OG as available assistant personalities.
The Art Studio is a Mansion add-on introduced with The Kortz Center Heist. Owning it unlocks the Heist planning flow and can also be used to display stolen artwork from successful finales.
Personal Vehicles are owned vehicles tied to the player's GTA Online character and storage. They can be stored in eligible garages and requested through supported vehicle-management systems.
where is my car gta online

If a vehicle seems missing, Rockstar recommends checking the Mechanic, Manage Vehicles, Mors Mutual Insurance, Pegasus, Terrorbyte, MOC, CEO Assistant, or the police impound lot depending on the vehicle type and situation.
Mors Mutual Insurance is used for eligible destroyed insured Personal Vehicles. If a vehicle was destroyed and is covered, it may need to be claimed before it can be requested again.

A Personal Vehicle can sometimes be held at the police impound lot. If the game indicates the vehicle is impounded, recover it there or use another supported retrieval method rather than assuming it was deleted.
Pegasus Lifestyle Management handles delivery for many non-Personal-Vehicle service vehicles and aircraft. Pegasus vehicles use their own request flow rather than the normal Mechanic garage flow.

The Mechanic is the standard service for requesting many owned Personal Vehicles from eligible garages. If the requested car does not appear, check whether it is destroyed, impounded, stored elsewhere, or unavailable because of the current activity.
what does avenger do gta online

The Avenger is a large service aircraft with configurable operational and workshop features depending on purchased modules. Later updates also let owners move it between supported storage locations through the Interaction Menu.
Weapon Workshops in supported properties or service vehicles let players modify eligible weapons, including access to Mk II variants where the content and prerequisites are available.
Gun Lockers in supported properties let players manage a custom weapon loadout so unwanted owned weapons can be hidden from normal weapon selection where the feature is supported.

Snacks and Body Armor are core survivability items in GTA Online. Many activities let players use them during combat, and Rockstar has added quality-of-life changes that restock or grant armor in selected missions.

Mk II weapon systems can support specialized ammunition types depending on the weapon, including options such as tracer, incendiary, armor-piercing, full-metal-jacket, hollow-point, or explosive ammunition.
The Race Creator lets players build custom races using routes, checkpoints, vehicle rules, props, and supported race options. Rockstar continues to add Creator controls and new race types.
